name: Press
summary: Touch-down acknowledgement with system-button states: scale + dim and one .tap haptic per touch, silent cancel on drag-out and re-entry, spring back on release, snap back when the system takes the touch.

states.motion: finger down inside: scale 1 → 0.96 + brightness −0.06, spring(response 0.18, damping 0.7)
states.haptic: .tap once per touch, at touch-down, before any visual work

states.motion: lifted while still pressed: back to 1.0 with the same spring, overshoot allowed; the Button's action fires
states.haptic: none (the next unit owns the result)

states.motion: dragged out past the Button's ~70 pt touch slop, held or lifted there: back to 1.0 with easeOut 0.16 s, no overshoot; dragging back resumes pressing
system took the touch (scroll, call, gesture conflict): snap back to 1.0 with easeOut 0.12 s

accessibility.reduceMotion: no scale, opacity dip to 0.75, easeOut 0.12 s for every state; phases and haptic unchanged
